title: Caixa changes Lotofácil da Independência draw time to 9 PM
seoTitle: Caixa changes Lotofácil da Independência draw time
subtitle: The draw will take place at 9 PM; bets close at 6 PM this Tuesday
excerpt: Caixa announced the special Lotofácil da Independência draw will be held at 9 PM, with bets open until 6 PM and an estimated R$ 300 million jackpot.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Caixa announced a change in the schedule for the special Lotofácil da Independência draw this Tuesday (15). The draw will take place at 9 PM, instead of the originally scheduled time of 11 AM.

The estimated jackpot for the draw is R$ 300 million. With this change, bets can be placed until 6 PM this Tuesday (15) at lottery outlets.

Players wishing to participate in the draw must pay attention to the new deadline for placing their bets and the updated time of the drawing.

With information from Agência Brasil.
